correctness.rationale: Fourier Parseval expresses M4 as the sum of squares of ordered-pair convolution coefficients and independently ordered-pair autocorrelations. Three independent character/constant phases uniquely enforce a00=a10=a01=1, leaving precisely q^7 gauge representatives. The source C++ code enumerates all 1+128+2187+16384+279936=298636 representatives via exact Gaussian/Eisenstein integer pair norms, cross-checks two forms and classifies minima, next levels, maxima; the Python orbit code normalizes all six barycentric permutations and conjugation. A separate vectorized integer convolution enumeration reproduced every minimum, count, maximum, next value and number of distinct moments, and a separately written symmetry check reproduced orbit-size partitions [1], [3], [2,6], [3,6,6,6,6,6,12], [6]. Source maximum 442 uses termwise triangle-inequality equality to enforce coefficient characters. This is exhaustive only for the five finite alphabets, not unrestricted phases.
